newsitem.title: UK: Bk of America forms structured trade finance group.
newsitem.headline: Bk of America forms structured trade finance group.

text.p: Bank of America said on Monday it had created a structured trade finance group in London, and appointed Harry Palumbo as head of the group's business in Europe, the Middle East and Africa.
The bank said in a statement that the new group replaces the former export finance group, which was headed by James Baird, who is leaving the company.
Bank of America already has structured trade finance groups in Chicago, New York, Los Angeles and San Francisco, Hong Kong, Tokyo, Frankfurt, Paris, Madrid and Milan.

The company said in a statement that Harry Palumbo, who is managing director, will have responsibility for increasing the team's scope to devise corporate finance solutions for clients' structured trade finance and capital raising needs in emerging markets.
He will be responsible for co-ordinating all the bank's European based export credit agency activity.

Palumbo currently works in Bank of America's New York structured trade finance team. His new appointment takes place with immediate effect, although until January 1997, he will divide his time between New York and London.
